company.name: Topkey
company.shortDescription: The ultimate financial operating system for property managers. (YC W21)
company.description:
Topkey is an app that tracks expenses by property, sync transactions across systems, and save tons of money on bookkeeping.



Topkey was founded in 2020 and was headquartered in San Francisco, USA.

productsAndServices.description: A unified financial platform for vacation rental managers that automates expense management, bookkeeping, banking, corporate cards, and accounts payable.
productsAndServices.name: Topkey Financial Operating System

productsAndServices.description: Automates expense tracking by capturing receipts in real time, tagging transactions to properties, and integrating with PMS and accounting software.
productsAndServices.name: Expense Management and Automated Receipt Capture

productsAndServices.description: Streamlines accounts payable with AI-driven invoice processing, vendor payments, property-level tagging, and customizable approval workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Bill Pay and Accounts Payable Automation

productsAndServices.description: Provides physical and virtual company credit cards with real-time transaction visibility and property-level expense tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Corporate and Virtual Company Cards

productsAndServices.description: Offers business checking and owner deposit accounts with integrated banking services and high-yield interest through a partner bank.
productsAndServices.name: Business Banking and Owner Deposit Accounts

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,200,000, or 97.65% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,409,415 to $28,263,700, a 11.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
